implement.summary: Coordinator remediation of the two P1 breaks the verify-4 adversary reproduced on bbb8b36a (attack branch devin/pp/w05-01/attack-bbb8b36a): (P1) OfflineWallet.load() returned nil — a fabricated empty wallet — when the wallet item was absent beside a tampered fence, a missing integrity key or a wrong-length key, while replace()/clear()/discardCorrupt() refused the same bytes; (P1) after discardCorrupt() crashed between the key deletion and the fence deletion, load() returned nil while replace() said integrity_key_missing. Root cause: load() only surfaced state.fault when walletBytes != nil || walletVanished. Fix: load() throws every classified fault (`if let fault = state.fault { throw fault }`), so all four entry points give the same verdict for the same persisted bytes. Also fixed the adversary's P3: the JS bridge preflight now rejects null/undefined/non-object contents as a typed invalid_grant instead of an untyped TypeError.
